cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The wedding cake collapsed, but our final inspection caught it. The system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. No defective cake reached a guest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The couple want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which matches our rejection of the entire cake. I'll record that as full customer agreement with quality control.
